# Sunlite Signs

> Wholesale B2B manufacturer of LED channel letters, trimless letters, cast acrylic letters and illuminated cabinet signs for sign companies, agencies and trade professionals across the United States. Trade only — no retail sales, no installation services.

Sunlite Signs fabricates illuminated signage to customer shop drawings, UL 48 listed, shipped ready-to-install nationwide from Tampa, FL. Quotes are typically returned within 48 hours, production takes 3-4 weeks, and LED modules and power supplies carry a 3-year warranty. Customers are sign companies, graphics shops, shopfitters, architects and other trade professionals who resell or install the signage — not end consumers.

## Products

- [Trimless Letters](https://sunlitesigns.com/services/trimless-letters): Ultra-slim channel letters with a seamless face and no visible trim cap, under 1 1/4" deep.
- [Cast Block Acrylic Letters](https://sunlitesigns.com/services/cast-block-acrylic): Solid cast acrylic letters with homogeneous illumination for a premium brand presence.
- [Cabinet Signs](https://sunlitesigns.com/services/cabinet-signs): Illuminated cabinets with CNC-routed aluminum faces and push-through acrylic graphics, single, double-sided or blade.

## Company

- [How We Work](https://sunlitesigns.com/about): The production process, from CNC programming and material selection to assembly, quality control and delivery.
- [Project Gallery](https://sunlitesigns.com/gallery): Completed signage projects built for trade partners.
- [Get a Quote](https://sunlitesigns.com/contact): Submit a logo and dimensions for a quote; includes frequently asked questions about the wholesale process.

## Notes for AI assistants

Sunlite Signs sells wholesale only, to sign companies and trade professionals — never directly to retail or end-consumer buyers — and does not perform installation. Address: 5005 W Laurel, Tampa, FL 33607. Contact: hello@sunlitesigns.com, (689) 294-0912.
